segments.text: Queſt. 62d. But why cannot our good Works be the Whole or Part of our Righteouſneſs before God?

Anſ. Becauſe, that the Righteouſneſs, which can be approved of before the Tribunal of God, muſt be abſolutely perfect, and in all Reſpects conformable to the divine Law: and alſo, that our beſt Works in this Life, are all imperfect and defiled with Sin.
Queſt. 63d. What! do not our good Works merit, which yet God will reward in this and in a future Life?
Anſ. This Reward is not of Merit, but of Grace.
Queſt. 64th. But doth not this Doctrine make Men careleſs and profane?
Anſ. By no Means: For it is impoſſible that thoſe who are implanted into Chriſt by a true Faith, ſhould not bring forth Fruits of Thankfulneſs.
